No DOM-only modules, browser HTML (div/span/pre/button/h4/p), window/document/navigator.clipboard, react-i18next, lucide-react, @/lib/cn, @/components/ui, @/components/feedback, @/components/motion, Recharts, or Leaflet appear in the native output — only React (useMemo/useState), react-native primitives (Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/View + StyleProp/ViewStyle), the native AppText/GlassPanel, and theme tokens. Explicit unavailable browser behaviour: clipboard write (web CopyButton) -> documented no-op + nativeResponseViewerCapabilities.clipboardAvailable=false. A companion __tests__/ResponseViewer.test.tsx (13 tests) exercises the loading/empty/response states, JSON-pretty vs raw bodyText, formatBytes (2.0 KB / 512 B), the green/amber/red status-bar tint, the response-headers toggle, the history strip (hidden-when-empty + replay), and the SnippetPanel (collapsed-until-toggled, cURL/Python/Go switching with the request reflected, copy button present).

Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; `npm run lint -- --quiet` (eslint .) exit 0; `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` -> 38 suites / 263 tests passed (incl. the new ResponseViewer + ApiPlaygroundPage suites).
